stories.headline: Jets QB Geno Smith to make preseason debut on Friday against Steelers
stories.blurb: Sources tell SNY NFL Insider Connor Hughes that Geno Smith, who has been dealing with ankle soreness, will start on Friday night against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
stories.summary: Sources tell SNY NFL Insider Connor Hughes that Geno Smith, who has been dealing with ankle soreness, will start on Friday night against the Pittsburgh Steelers. Jets quarterback Geno Smith will make his first start of the 2026 preseason Friday night against the Pittsburgh Steelers. Smith missed the Jets’ preseason opener against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers with a minor ankle injury. Aggregated from SNY, SB Nation.
